committee: *PRESENTATION NOTICE for Certificate 272-38 (COR) - Office of Senator Borja
title: Håfa Adai! Please be advised that on Thursday, January 15, 2026, at 9:00 AM. Senator Vincent A. V. Borja will hand-deliver Certificate 272-38 (COR), relative to recognizing the Saint John’s School for your dedicated commitment and leadership in the sport of Basketball; and to congratulate you as the winners of the 2025 ISA Girls’ Basketball Championship. We look forward to your attendance and participation.
